sn54.11:1.1: Icchānaṅgala was a center east of Sāvatthī for the innovative brahmins of the Kosala region.
sn54.11:2.5: Given the consistency of this formula, it seems that the variations in the Buddha’s own meditation are meaningful and should be reflected in translation. These are the omission of va (“just”) here; the omission of vā (“or”) below; and the omission of sikkhati (“one trains”).
sn54.11:3.2: Here we find “divine meditation” (brahmavihāra), which is normally associated with the four immeasurables.
